groups.operation: Parse a four-component OBJ v line and publish vertex_weights.
groups.condition: A v line has a fourth component.
groups.capability: Retain the fourth component in vertex_weights and transfer it to output attributes.
groups.consequence: The vertex weight is missing or incorrect.
groups.equivalence_reason: No other candidate concerns vertex-weight extraction.

groups.operation: Accept an OBJ vertex without RGB components through ParseFromString.
groups.capability: Accept the vertex without supplying fallback colors.
groups.consequence: The vertex is rejected or fallback colors are supplied.
groups.equivalence_reason: No other candidate concerns the disabled vertex-color fallback path.

groups.operation: Export a polygon face through LoadObj and exportGroupsToShape.
groups.capability: Preserve the polygon face without triangulating it, if supported.
groups.consequence: The polygon is triangulated or not preserved.
groups.equivalence_reason: No other candidate concerns untriangulated polygon export.
